code='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    seen = set()
    components = []
    sizes = {}
    # Find 4-connected components of each foreground color.
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] == bg or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            color = grid[r][c]
            stack = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while stack:
                y, x = stack.pop()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for ny, nx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                    if 0 <= ny < h and 0 <= nx < w and (ny,nx) not in seen and grid[ny][nx] == color:
                        seen.add((ny,nx)); stack.append((ny,nx))
            components.append(cells)
            for y, x in cells:
                sizes[y, x] = len(cells)
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    # Tiny foreground components are stray marks. Restore a pixel only when it
    # sits inside a larger object (at least two orthogonal neighbors agree).
    for cells in components:
        if len(cells) > 2:
            continue
        for r, c in cells:
            neighbors = [grid[y][x] for y,x in ((r-1,c),(r+1,c),(r,c-1),(r,c+1))
                         if 0 <= y < h and 0 <= x < w]
            objects = Counter(v for v in neighbors if v != bg and sizes.get((r + (v==grid[r][c]), c), 0) > 2)
            # General local neighbor vote, ignoring other stray pixels.
            objects = Counter(v for v in neighbors if v != bg and v != grid[r][c]
                              and any(sizes.get((y,x), 0) > 2 and grid[y][x] == v
                                      for y,x in ((r-1,c),(r+1,c),(r,c-1),(r,c+1))
                                      if 0 <= y < h and 0 <= x < w))
            out[r][c] = objects.most_common(1)[0][0] if objects and objects.most_common(1)[0][1] >= 2 else bg
    return out
'''
